claim: Variety-tail cannibalisation and suppression were both REFUTED and no change shipped. Do NOTHING to the tail: noindexing the dead 94% would cost ~10% of variety clicks to prevent a penalty we have no evidence of.

body.decision: DEC-266 / DAL-250 (2026-08-06). Tested and REFUTED. No change shipped.
body.premise_was_stale: The ticket said 1,659 variety pages. There are 2,765 (2,764 in sitemaps/variety.xml). The tail grew 67% unnoticed.
body.cannibalisation_refuted: GSC query x page, 28d, 9,450 rows paginated. 503 queries served by both a variety page and another page type; the variety page is OUTRANKED on 434 of them, typically position 48-79 beneath a species/compare page at 7-13. Clicks: variety 5, other types 23. A result at #58 does not take a click from a result at #7.
body.suppression_refuted: The experiment already ran: the tail grew 376 -> 2,765 pages Mar-Aug while GSC recorded the rest of the site. Non-variety impressions 5,831 -> 60,199, clicks 89 -> 1,357, avg position 18.4 -> 14.1, CTR 1.5% -> 2.3%, monotonic across 5 consecutive 28-day windows. The hypothesis predicts decline or stall; every metric improved while the thin tail was at its largest.
body.suppression_caveat: Natural experiment, not controlled. Species+state pages were added over the same period, so it is not proven the site would not have grown MORE without the tail. The claim is only that a specific prediction was made and contradicted.
body.crawl_budget_unknown: NOT MEASURABLE and recorded as unknown, not zero (DEC-249). The treestock Caddy site block has no `log` directive so no access log exists, and GSC Crawl Stats is not exposed by the API. Do not reason about crawl starvation from absence of data.
body.tail_value_28d: GSC 336 clicks (20% of site's 1,693); top 200 pages carry 90%.
body.tail_referral_30d: 255 outbound clicks (18% of all 1,400); 154 pages carry 100% of them; 2,611 of 2,765 (94%) sent zero.
body.zero_impression_pages: 1,061 of 2,765 (38%) got no impression in 28 days.
body.recommendation: Do NOTHING to the tail. Noindexing the dead 94% would cost ~10% of variety search clicks to prevent a penalty we have no evidence of. Effort belongs on DAL-249 (species+state), best page type on SEO yield and referral yield independently.
